# Plot it point by point

<!-- STEP id="point" -->
At 1 s the position is 20 m. Find 1 s on the X-axis, go straight up to the line for 20 m, and mark a point there. Do the same for every row of the table.

<!-- STEP id="line" -->
Join the points. They lie on a straight line.

If the speed is constant, a point on the line between two marks gives the position at an in-between time too.
